duty_calendar.note: Gold (Control) Act 1968 (Act 45 of 1968, commenced 1968-09-01) era: gold imports under complete prohibition, black-market pricing. Annotate only - pre-1990 is not modeled (TECH-DESIGN section 4.1); row anchored at GCA commencement, earlier years out of model scope.

Gold (Control) Repeal Act 1990 (Act 18 of 1990, FM Madhu Dandavate) liberalised imports at Rs 250/10g; official imports ~nil (1991) -> >110 t (1992). NRI/passenger channel diverges 1992-03-01 (see nri_baggage row).
notif 171/94-Cus (30.09.1994): Rs 220/10g; passenger purchases from bonded warehouses also permitted; passenger channel = standard rate from this date.
notif 2/99-Cus (04.01.1999): Rs 400/10g; corroborated by EPWRF ('raised from Rs 250 to Rs 400 per 10 grams').
notif 31/2003-Cus (01.03.2003): standard bars/coins Rs 100/10g (modeled); non-standard Rs 250/10g; rate split introduced by purity/serial-number.
notif 78/2009-Cus (07.07.2009): standard Rs 200/10g (modeled); non-standard Rs 500/10g.
notif 17/2010-Cus (27.02.2010): standard Rs 300/10g (modeled; ~1.08% ad-valorem equivalent at prevailing prices); non-standard Rs 750/10g. Last specific-rate regime.
notif 3/2012-Cus (16.01.2012): switch from fixed levy to ad valorem, 2% w.e.f. 17.01.2012; CBIC fortnightly tariff-value mechanism introduced.
6% w.e.f. 21.01.2013, against record CAD (FY13 imports 845 t per PIB).
8% w.e.f. 05.06.2013; CVD on dore 6% -> 8%, excise on refined gold 7% -> 9%; RBI 80:20 circular follows 22.07.2013.
10% w.e.f. 13.08.2013; carried flat 2014-2018. Part 1 of 2 - row split at the GST start 2017-07-01 (see gst_rate column). SWS not verified for gold by dive_05 in this window; left empty (not zero).
10% era part 2 of 2 (split at GST start 2017-07-01): duty unchanged, gst_rate 0.03 begins. SWS not verified for gold by dive_05 in this window; left empty (not zero).
Budget 05.07.2019, effective 06.07.2019: BCD 12.5% + SWS 1.25% (10% of BCD) = 13.75% total customs (WGC).
Budget 01.02.2021: BCD 7.5% (dore 6.9%) + AIDC 2.5% + SWS 0.75% (10% of BCD, exempt on AIDC) = 10.75% effective; WGC total tax incl 3% IGST 14.07% (from 16.26%).
Budget 01.02.2022: BCD 10% + AIDC 5% = 15% effective (hiked from 10.75%); SWS nil on gold.
Budget 23.07.2024, effective 24.07.2024: BCD 5% + AIDC 1% = 6% effective; sharpest reduction on record, lowest since Jun 2013; dore 14.35% -> 5.35%.

Order of 12.05.2026, effective 13.05.2026: BCD 10% + AIDC 5% = 15% effective (reversal of the Jul-2024 cut); Notification 15/2026 harmonises Chapter 71; SWS apparently nil on gold (dive_05 section 10). CURRENT at transcription (2026-11-21).

episodes.event: Ban era: private gold imports prohibited; smuggled gold sold at a black-market premium. Consumption grew from about 50 t (1980) to 175 t (1985). No premium figure documented.
80:20 import restriction: supply crunch pushed dealer premiums to a record for the era in December 2013.
80:20 scrapped: import glut followed; Diwali 2015 sales fell about 50% as dealers discounted. Size not documented.
Duty hiked to 12.5%: industry feared a smuggling surge; no dealer premium figure documented.
Five months of discounts ahead of the July 2024 duty cut; platinum-alloy arbitrage blamed. No magnitude documented.
Duty cut to 6%: demand surged and the domestic price fell 7% on Budget day; WGC models +50 t of H2 2024 demand. Premium not quantified.
Record world prices dulled festival demand despite the 6% duty.
After record November imports, weak demand kept discounts small.
